request.utterance: SUE-1726 round 9, on branch feat/sue-1726-pm-carousel in the AES repo. Start from out/sue-1726-sample-r8/ and render to out/sue-1726-sample-r9/. The r8 direction is right: number visuals are the hero. The execution is too plain and too small. Scale visuals to fill 55–65% of each card; hero numbers at least 140px, labels at least 34px, body at least 32px at 1080 width. Use the punchy r7 headlines in Noto Serif KR: 10월엔 쉬고, 12월엔 올린다; 인상 기대, 한 발 물러섰다; 물가는 뜨겁고, 고용은 느려졌다; 동결과 인상, 체감은 다르다. Trend: smooth curve with visible weekly wiggle using real intermediate PMC points, smoothed; gradient area, 90% start dot, large 81% end label and -9%p delta chip. Scenario branches: 동결 → 원·달러 상승압력 완화 · 대출금리 숨 고르기; 인상 → 금리차 1.25%p로 확대 · 변동금리 상방. Korea: 금리차 gap bracket and outflow vs inflow proportion bars (2.5:1), labels 나가는 돈 / 들어오는 돈; remove USD bn jargon. Add subtle chart-panel shadow, coral plus navy. No caveats, disclaimers or meta words. Keep real numbers matching brief. Image spend cap USD 0.04. Phone-size self-review and re-render if small or plain. Tests must pass. Commit and push.
